notes: Reached ES storefront via the Akamai interstitial proof-of-work solver (curl_cffi chrome-impersonation session), same method as sibling passes. Checked: the full mega-menu tree embedded as JSON in the homepage's serverApp-state, robots.txt (no Claude-named disallow), and the site's own ES category sitemap (sitemap-home-categories-zh-es-0.xml.gz, 1670 URLs, full-text scanned for 'rebaj'/'liquidac'/'outlet'/'ofert'/'descuento'/'sale'/'clearance' substrings). The only discount/markdown-style page anywhere on the ES storefront is 'Special Prices', a top-level nav item with its own standalone canonical URL https://www.zarahome.com/es/special-prices-n1170 (confirmed present in the sitemap as its own page, seoId 1170 -- the exact same shared Inditex taxonomy node GB uses at /gb/special-prices-n1170 and its equivalent on DE, not a celement-anchored widget like the site's non-genuine Bestsellers entries). Opened it directly and inspected the actual page: <title> = 'Zara Home Special Prices | Zara Home Espana'; its own <meta name=description> reads verbatim 'Aprovecha las rebajas y descuentos de Zara Home por tiempo limitado en una variedad de productos de temporada, desde ropa de cama hasta decoracion para tu hogar' -- i.e. 'Take advantage of Zara Home's discounts and savings FOR A LIMITED TIME on a variety of seasonal products' -- the site's own copy explicitly signals a temporary/seasonal campaign, not permanent markdown. Full-text scanned the rendered page for liquidacion/outlet/fin de serie/ultimas unidades/permanente/descatalogado/stock limitado language: zero genuine hits (the only 'outlet' substring matches, 10 total, were all Angular <router-outlet> component tags, not page content, individually verified). No breadcrumb, heading, or on-page copy anywhere frames it as permanent-markdown/outlet/end-of-line stock. Per the brief's Clearance-vs-Sale test (a page called Sale/Offers/Discounts with no permanence signal is excluded, not force-included), this is a generic promotional/seasonal Sale page, not Clearance -- excluded with confidence, not flagged as ambiguous, since the page's own self-description and the explicit 'por tiempo limitado' (limited-time) wording leave no real doubt. This matches the GB and DE sibling findings on the identical shared taxonomy node (seoId 1170). No separate Outlet/Liquidacion/Rebajas-permanentes/Fin-de-serie URL exists anywhere in nav, sitemap, or robots.txt. Concluding no genuine Clearance PLP exists on Zara Home ES.
